name: Wobble

# wobble

Wobble animation effect

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| speed | float | 5.0 | 0-5 | Animation speed |
| range | float | 0.5 | 0-5 | Wobble amplitude |
| wrap | int | mirror | mirror/repeat/clamp | Wrap |
